text:
mira: Heads up 1: customer wants a bespoke 'soft credit' for tier bump during holiday spike. Can we spec a safe product flow?

anika: Need guardrails: timebox, measurable cap, billing label, and a reclaim ability. No SLA changes.

ryan_sales: CustomerBright asked for 2 weeks unlimited burst. They'll pay more but ops can't absorb risk. We can offer a paid add-on or a one-off soft credit.

legal_sam: Contract note: call it a 'Promotional Soft Credit' with expiry and no implied capacity guarantee. Must be non-renewing unless signed addendum.

ops_lee: Implementation: tag all requests with billing.credit_id, enforce per-account multiplier (max 3x baseline), decrement credit_units at serve time. Provide console view with credit balance and an emergency reclaim button.

finance_zoe: Also need invoice line item semantics: negative balance adjustments when credit is applied, and a preview before activation. If refunded, mark audit event.

mira: Example minimal config we can enforce (for dev): 
- credit_id: promo_soft_v1
- units: 50000
- multiplier_cap: 3.0
- expiry_ts: 1751540000
- emergency_reclaimable: true

ryan_sales: Sales wants auto-apply toggle so customers can opt-in during checkout. Must surface cost and expiry.

ops_lee: If auto-apply enabled we need an acceptance checkbox and an API param so SDKs can opt-in. Also create alerts at 60% and 90% consumption.

infra-bot: Ticket PROD-4721 created: implement billing.credit_id, UI balance panel, reclaim endpoint. Owner=ops_lee, due=2025-05-12.

legal_sam: Suggested contract blurb: "Promotional Soft Credits are non-transferable, expire on the stated date, and do not create a capacity or performance guarantee. Usage beyond credited units will be billed at standard overage rates."

mira: Launch gating (quick): 1) enforcement in serving + billing tag propagation verified, 2) console shows credit and reclaim, 3) invoice preview + marketing copy, 4) legal sign-off, 5) runbook for reclaim and customer comms.

finance_zoe: Also ensure GAAP-friendly accounting: mark promotional credits as contra-revenue where applicable. Finance to confirm with external audit team if large credits used.

ryan_sales: We should cap number of one-offs per quarter to avoid precedent. Recommend approval queue: AM -> Sales Director -> VP revenue.

mira: Agree. Add an internal field approval_path and an immutable audit trail for every credit.

ops_lee: Emergency reclaim flow: set reclaim=true on credit -> system drains remaining credited units and routes requests to fallback tier. Must emit customer-facing notification.

infra-bot: PROD-4721 updated: added fields audit_trail=true, approval_path_required=true, reclaim_endpoint=true.

mira: OK. I'll draft the spec + UI mocks and ping Legal + Finance for sign-off. Target: ready by EOD Monday.

ryan_sales: I'll draft a short playbook for customer comms and approvals.

legal_sam: I'll prepare the standard contract snippet and escalation matrix.

mira: Thanks all. We'll lock policy after sign-offs.
